notes:
OUTPUT_LOAD still performs the initial synchronous RAM read. Each accepted nonfinal byte loads the next byte on that same edge, keeping OUTPUT_SEND active for one byte per clock. Stalls hold data, index, valid, first/last, rate, length and FCS status stable. The final handshake returns to IDLE without another read. RAM remains unreset with clocked reads; the mutually exclusive reads may infer two read ports. Synchronous reset and all decoding logic remain unchanged.

With acceptance at edge H, cooldown 798 reaches zero after H+798. PREP_SEND sees zero and registers backend_iv at H+799; the backend accepts at H+800. Thus minimum acceptance spacing is exactly 800 clocks; backpressure can only extend it. The FFT cooldown remains unchanged. No tools or simulation were run.
